what.text: This page follows refugees from Tajikistan in Turkmenistan, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year from 1993 to 2005.
At the end of 2005, the last year in UNHCR's series for this group, it counted 11173 refugees, 20.4% of all Tajik refugees that year.
Today refugees from Tajikistan live mostly in Germany, the United States, the United Kingdom and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Tajikistan from 1992 to 1998, at war level in some of those years, and again in 2000 and from 2010 to 2011.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1993 to 2005, begin during the first of these periods.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1993 at 15000 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 20000, at the end of 1995, and was lower when the series ends in 2005.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they lived in Turkmenistan.
These are year-end totals for Turkmenistan only, reported to UNHCR, and the series ends in 2005.
